status: pre-registered independent material reference, no candidate implementation
reference_method: Independent direct real rotation matrix times diagonal residue and its transpose, divided by the complex rational denominator 1+j*f/p. Moderate frequencies only; future candidate must additionally test stable extreme-frequency evaluation separately.
proof: For each residue A_k=R diag(nonnegative strengths) R^T, v^T A_k v>=0. Real epsilon=E_inf+sum A_k/(1+x_k^2) is >=I. Loss=-Im(epsilon)=sum A_k*x_k/(1+x_k^2) is PSD for f>=0. Time-domain susceptibility is sum (2*pi*p_k)*A_k*exp(-2*pi*p_k*t)*H(t), plus instantaneous E_inf; all poles are negative real, establishing causal finite Debye response. This does not identify measured materials or assert validity beyond a fitted/measured range.
acceptance: Reference matrices symmetric within1e-14 relative, eigenvalues of real>=1 and loss>=-1e-12 scale. At declared frequencies demonstrate max pairwise normalized commutator of real matrices>1e-3 and normalized real/loss commutator>1e-3; this proves no one fixed real principal frame covers the fixture. No eigenvector tracking or mode certificate. Future candidate rational-model agreement1e-12 and old-family subset equivalence retain separate tests.
limits: Reference analysis only during previous manufacturing regression; no model/JSON/code promotion or product support claim. Use existing numpy, no new dependency or external dataset.
